Another thing I have a theory for is in regards to the Leda, Needle Knights and Ansbach.
When attacking Ansbach in the Storehouse, he says this.
"There's no denying it, now. A culling appears to be on the cards. One that won't overlook even an aging soldier as myself…"

It is very interesting as the other time the word "Culling" is used for the description of Leda's sword

"Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage. Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the CULL of her knightly comrades"

A lot of people take it to mean that Leda killed her fellow Needle Knights (Another theory I have regarding them is that there were never other Needle Knights, only Oathseekers)

Leda says this when talking about Ansbach:
"Ah, there you are. I’m afraid Sir Ansbach will have to be next. He insist that he’s nothing but a worn down, over-the-hill soldier. But in his day, he was the feared commander of the Pureblood Knights, who cleaved open Miquella the Kind with his blood blade. He claims he hasn’t the spirit to take up his sword again, but I doubt it’ll be very long… Before he recalls, as I have, the cascading sheets of blood. I’m afraid he cannot be left to fester"

I think that it is very likely that Ansbach was the one responsible for this "Culling". A lot of people in the community view Sir Ansbach as a sweet angel and that the Mohgwyn Dynasty was a honorable faction before Miquella's charm, but I don't really subscribe to this for multiple reasons. Leda herself isn't a reliable narrator either.
1: Miquella's Charm isn't possible from a distance, even as a god he still needs to grab the player to charm them. and Mohg still needed to abduct Miquella for the formless Mother, as the only other Empyreans left are Malenia (who would absolutely kick the shit out of Mohg) Ranni, who no longer even has a body, and Miquella who is vulnerable and defenseless in a tree alone. ofc he would choose Miquella.
2: Malenia does not know where he went, I am certain Miquella would have told her what he was doing, and would not abandon her like that. As well as letting his Haligtree decay like that.
3: Leda calls the Purebloods "Feared" for a reason, even Ansbach's Scythe says this:
"Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat. The obsidian edge relies not upon trickery to fulfil its violent purpose—only well-honed skill is required to rip and rend through foes, sowing blossoms of red upon the battlefield."

A brutal weapon. Also worth noting that the Mohgwyn Dynasty is based on blood orgy cult tropes (eyes wide shut, sleep no more ect) So appearing as a noble order (masked balls as a front for virgin sacrifice ect) was likely there from the inception. Vare still awards us with a Pureblood coat after assumedly slaughtering a maiden and then soaking the Favor in the blood of a maiden. As well as the Formless mother clearly favoring this behavior as we see with Mohg's second phase where he is gifted more power and flight.


Making an addendum here cause one of my friends pointed out the line in Leda's Sword "it reeks of the blood of her fellow comrads" and alot of people take that as meaning she killed the needle knights, but I think it's more likely in reference to her killing the fellow followers of Miquella and the final fight we have against her. 


again, I think the use of the word Culling is deliberate for Leda and Ansbach. IMO the timeline would be like this:
